svg.title: Paintbrush Yoke Shirt, round 2. Neo-Western lane, Visit Salt Lake
svg.text: Chain stitch on the back yoke. Indian paintbrush and lupine, the way they grow in Albion Basin in July.
paintbrush in Rodeo Red and Terracotta, lupine in Sky and Light Sky, Sage stems
paintbrush in Sego Lily and Aspen Gold, lupine in Sky and Cream, Sage stems

text.tspan: One cluster of paintbrush and lupine, chain-stitched on the yoke so the loops catch the light the way a
July meadow does. Nothing on the front. Roll the left cuff and the facing says where the flowers came from.
